families.name: Telephones
families.cardLine: Industrial, PA, weatherproof, IP, clean-room, hotline and rail phones

categories.name: Industrial Telephones
categories.intro: Line-powered and AC-powered telephones for noisy, dusty plant floors, in 16-gauge steel or ABS. Wall, desk, loud-hearing, vandal-resistant and GSM versions work on the SMART MCS-III or any plant EPABX.
categories.cardLine: Steel and desk phones for noisy plant floors, on any EPABX
categories.metaDescription: SMART industrial telephones: line-powered steel wall phones, desk, loud-hearing, vandal-resistant and GSM models for noisy plants on any EPABX.

categories.name: PA Telephones
categories.intro: Telephones that page. Each SMART PA telephone carries its own 30 W amplifier and horn, so a call is announced where the phone is and goes private when the handset is lifted.
categories.cardLine: Phones with a built-in 30 W amplifier that page their own horn
categories.seoTitle: PA Telephones with Built-in Amplifier | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART PA telephones with a built-in 30 W amplifier: dial to page the horn at that location, lift to talk privately. Handset, hands-free, desktop.

categories.name: Weatherproof & Flameproof Telephones
categories.intro: Phones for open plant areas where water, dust and weather wreak havoc. Cast-aluminium housings with integrated canopies, in line-powered, PA and VoIP versions, plus a flameproof-housing PA telephone.
categories.cardLine: Cast-aluminium phones for rain, dust and open plant areas
categories.metaDescription: SMART weatherproof telephones in cast aluminium with integrated canopies: line-powered, PA and VoIP models, plus a flameproof-housing PA telephone.

categories.name: IP / VoIP Telephones & Systems
categories.intro: SIP phones, IP PA telephones and VoIP PA master stations that run on the plant fibre, Ethernet or Wi-Fi already in place. Page across the plant from IP field phones, with PoE options.
categories.cardLine: SIP phones and VoIP PA systems on plant fibre and Wi-Fi
categories.seoTitle: IP & VoIP Industrial Phones and PA Systems | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART IP and VoIP equipment: SIP phones for any IP PABX, IP PA telephones with 30 W amplifiers, and VoIP PA systems over fibre, Ethernet or Wi-Fi.

categories.name: Clean Room Phones
categories.intro: Flush-mount, hands-free phones for clean rooms, packing cubicles, dispensing areas and labs. Analogue and SIP versions, in powder-coated steel or full stainless steel.
categories.cardLine: Flush-mount hands-free phones for pharma clean rooms and labs
categories.seoTitle: Clean Room Phones for Pharma & Labs | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART clean room phones: flush-mount and hands-free, analogue or SIP, in powder-coated steel or full stainless steel. For pharma, packing and labs.

categories.name: Hotline Systems
categories.intro: Direct lines with no dialling: lift the handset and the other end rings or pages. Copper, PA-paging and single-mode fibre versions, all with a SMART controller.
categories.cardLine: Lift-to-ring hotlines over copper or single-mode fibre
categories.metaDescription: SMART hotline systems: lift a handset and the other end rings or pages, no dialling. Up to 4 phones on one pair, PA hotlines, fibre links to 10 km.

categories.name: Rail & Metro Telephones
categories.intro: Emergency telephones for railway and metro track lines, tunnels and stations, in IP 65 die-cast aluminium. Line-powered analogue and SIP versions, with or without keypad.
categories.cardLine: IP 65 die-cast emergency phones for rail and metro track
categories.metaDescription: SMART emergency rail telephones for railway and metro track lines: IP 65 die-cast aluminium, analogue line-powered or SIP, keypad or non-keypad.

families.name: Plant PA & Paging
families.cardLine: Master stations, consoles, amplifiers, horns and crane links

categories.name: Plant Communication (PA) Systems
categories.intro: Paging and private talk across a whole plant. Distributed-amplifier MCS-II, central-amplifier MCS-III and the ISAS safety announcement system, plus stand-alone page/private and 1+1 pagephone sets.
categories.cardLine: Master stations and loop systems for plant-wide paging
categories.seoTitle: Plant PA & Paging Systems: MCS-II, MCS-III | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART plant communication systems: MCS-II distributed and MCS-III central-amplifier PA, ISAS safety announcements, page/private and 1+1 pagephones.

categories.name: Operator Consoles, Amplifiers & Loudspeakers
categories.intro: The control-room and loudspeaker end of a SMART PA system. Operator consoles for MCS-II, MCS-III and page/private systems, external and rack amplifiers, and indoor and outdoor speakers.
categories.cardLine: Control-room consoles, amplifiers and horns for SMART PA systems
categories.seoTitle: PA Operator Consoles, Amplifiers & Horns | SMART
categories.metaDescription: Operator consoles for SMART MCS-II, MCS-III and page/private systems, 100 W and 250 W paging amplifiers, outdoor horns and indoor box speakers.

categories.name: Crane Communication
categories.intro: Talk and announce on giant and high cranes, where cabling or position rules out other communication. A walkie-talkie-based announcement unit and a cabin-to-crane talk link.
categories.cardLine: Announcement and talk links for giant and high cranes
categories.metaDescription: SMART crane communication: a walkie-talkie-based announcement unit and a cabin-to-crane talk link for up to 5 points, for giant and high cranes.

families.name: Alarms & Emergency
families.cardLine: SOS call boxes, hooters, flashers, voice alarms and lift alarm

categories.name: Emergency Call Boxes
categories.intro: One-button SOS boxes for highways, stations, ports and docks, on GSM or VoIP, with solar options. The control-room rack and software log, record and monitor every box.
categories.cardLine: GSM and VoIP SOS call boxes with control-room logging
categories.seoTitle: Emergency Call Boxes for Highways & Rail | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART emergency call boxes: one-button hands-free SOS on GSM or VoIP with solar options, plus a server rack and software that log every call.

categories.name: Hooters, Flashers & Loud Ringers
categories.intro: Sound and light for alarms and incoming calls in noisy plant areas. Electronic hooters, a hooter cum LED flasher, a telephone loud ringer and a call flasher visible from 100 m.
categories.cardLine: Hooters, loud ringers and LED flashers for noisy plant areas
categories.seoTitle: Industrial Hooters, Flashers & Loud Ringers | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART hooters, flashers and loud ringers: 100 W six-tone hooter, 30 W hooter with LED flasher, telephone loud ringer, call flasher visible at 100 m.

categories.name: Voice Alarms & Messagers
categories.intro: A recorded voice instead of a bare siren. Relay-triggered voice alarms from 1 to 32+ channels, and an outdoor voice messager in Hindi and English.
categories.cardLine: Relay-triggered voice alarms and outdoor message players
categories.metaDescription: SMART voice alarms: a relay contact starts a siren and a recorded message, 1 to 32+ channels. Plus an outdoor voice messager in Hindi and English.

categories.name: Lift Alarm
categories.intro: A recordable voice module that plays while the lift door switch stays closed. Messages up to 40 s in English, Hindi or Marathi.
categories.seoTitle: Lift Alarm System, Door-Open Voice Alert | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART LA-1 lift alarm: a recordable voice module that plays "Please close the door" in English, Hindi or Marathi while the lift door stays open.

families.name: Process Instruments
families.cardLine: Bag counters for loading lines and 4–20 mA displays

categories.name: Bag Counters
categories.intro: Bag counters for truck and wagon loading in cement, fertiliser, rice and sugar plants. Eleven models with sensing-head, ultrasonic, diffused-optic and dual-optic sensors, from preset counters to network models with Ethernet output.
categories.cardLine: Bag counters for truck and wagon loading lines
categories.seoTitle: Bag Counters for Cement & Fertiliser Loading | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART bag counters for truck and wagon loading: 11 models, optical and non-contact sensors, totalisers, conveyor stop contacts and Ethernet output.

categories.name: Display Units
categories.intro: Large LED displays that show a 4–20 mA process value in engineering units. 4-digit 4 in and 3-digit 8 in versions, factory calibrated.
categories.cardLine: Large LED displays for 4–20 mA process values
categories.seoTitle: 4–20 mA Large LED Display Units | SMART
categories.metaDescription: SMART 4–20 mA display units: large LED digits show temperature, pressure or level in engineering units, ±0.25% accuracy, 4 in or 8 in digits.

families.name: Lighting
families.cardLine: LED floodlights and an LED emergency light

categories.name: LED Lighting
categories.intro: LED floodlights from 30 W to 100 W that replace sodium and mercury vapour lamps in factory areas and walkways. Plus a 3 W LED emergency light with Li-ion battery backup.
categories.cardLine: LED floodlights and a Li-ion emergency light
categories.metaDescription: SMART LED lighting: 30 W to 100 W floodlights replacing sodium and mercury vapour lamps, IP 65 models, and a 3 W LED emergency light with Li-ion.
